snippet.title: Fireball 2 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Fireball 2 is an elegant and satisfying arcade survival game for Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Dodge and boost your way through a massive flood of enemies. Lure them into range and detonate a devastating bomb! Features infinite waves, two difficulties, local co-op, dazzling visuals, and an epic soundscape.

Fireball's launches on May 6th, 2025.

Fireball 2 can found here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647800/Fireball_2/
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014335/
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/fireball-2/9PFMVT801G6Q/0010
